subtitle: Enter your topic. Get 3 ready-to-post caption variants for any social platform.
resultDisclaimer: Review before posting. Adjust hashtags and details to match your actual post.
whatIsText: Writing captions takes longer than it should. This tool reads your topic and generates 3 different caption variants formatted for the platform you're posting on — Instagram, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, or TikTok. Each variant takes a different angle so you can pick the one that fits the moment.
plat1: Instagram — 1-3 short sentences plus 8-12 hashtags. Visual and conversational.
plat2: X (Twitter) — Under 280 characters including hashtags. Punchy and opinionated.
plat3: LinkedIn — 2-4 sentences. Professional and insightful. Fewer hashtags.
plat4: Facebook — Friendly, community-oriented, ends with a question to drive comments.
plat5: TikTok — Short hook-driven text plus 5-7 hashtags. Sounds like a creator, not a brand.
faq1a: Yes. It runs on Cloudflare Workers AI with a free daily quota. Normal use won't hit limits.
faq2a: You should. The generated captions are a starting point. Add specific details, adjust the hashtags to match your niche, and replace any placeholders with real information.
faq3a: Hashtags generated by AI are reasonable but generic. For best results, mix AI-generated hashtags with 2-3 niche hashtags specific to your account or community. Generic hashtags like #love or #instagood attract bots, not real engagement.
faq4a: No. Your topic and details are sent to the AI model for processing and discarded immediately after. Nothing is stored, logged, or used for training.
faq5q: Can it write in other languages?
faq5a: The model can write in most major languages. Just enter your topic in that language and the output will follow. The interface itself is currently English and Simplified Chinese.
disclaimer: Note: Captions are drafts. Always review before posting — especially for hashtags and any brand-specific claims.
footer: Runs on Cloudflare Workers AI. Your text is not stored.

howIntro: One topic, three angles, formatted for the platform you chose.
how1d: What is the photo or video actually showing? A sentence is enough, and specifics beat adjectives.
how2d: Length and hook style change between Instagram and LinkedIn. Tone decides whether the caption is funny, plain, or earnest.
how3d: The three variants take different angles: direct, story-led, and question-led. Take one or blend two.
whenTitle: Where this fits into a posting routine
use1t: Daily posting with a small team
use1d: Batch a week of captions in one sitting instead of writing them one by one.
use2d: The same photo needs different wording on X and Instagram. Generate per platform rather than reusing.
use3d: Three variants give the client a real choice instead of a yes-no decision.
use4t: When the photo is fine but the words are not
use4d: Hooks fail more often than images. Rewrite the first line before reshooting.

faq6a: They are suggested, not inserted automatically. Generic tags add little, so keep two or three that describe the actual post.
faq7q: Can I generate for several platforms at once?
faq7a: Run it once per platform. Caption length and hook style differ enough that a single version rarely works in both places.
faq8a: Match the account. If the last ten posts used none, a caption full of emoji will look off-brand regardless of quality.
